prisons.name: Fox River State Penitentiary
prisons.description: A maximum security prison where Michael Scofield deliberately gets himself incarcerated to break out his brother Lincoln Burrows, who is on death row.

prisons.name: Sona Federal Penitentiary
prisons.description: A lawless prison with no guards inside its walls, run by the inmates themselves. Michael is imprisoned here on a fabricated homicide charge.

prisons.name: Miami-Dade Metropolitan Correctional Center
prisons.description: A federal holding facility briefly used to detain James Whistler before his transfer to Sona.

prisons.name: GATE Facility
prisons.description: A secretive government detention site used by General Krantz and The Company to hold and interrogate operatives connected to Scylla.

prisons.name: Ogygia Prison
prisons.description: A prison in Yemen where Michael Scofield resurfaces years after being presumed dead, living under the alias Kaniel Outis.

characters.name: Michael Scofield
characters.description: Mastermind behind the Fox River escape plan, tattooed with a coded blueprint of the prison to break out his brother Lincoln.

characters.name: Lincoln Burrows
characters.description: Michael's older brother, wrongly convicted of murdering the Vice President's brother and sentenced to death.

characters.name: Fernando Sucre
characters.description: Michael's loyal cellmate at Fox River, driven to escape so he can marry his girlfriend Maricruz.

characters.name: Theodore 'T-Bag' Bagwell
characters.description: A manipulative and dangerous sociopath who forces his way into the escape plan and becomes a recurring antagonist.

characters.name: Brad Bellick
characters.role: Correctional Officer / Captain of the Guards
characters.description: Corrupt head guard at Fox River whose fortunes rise and fall dramatically throughout the series.

characters.name: Alexander Mahone
characters.description: A skilled but morally compromised federal agent assigned to hunt down the Fox River escapees.

characters.name: Sara Tancredi
characters.description: Fox River's doctor who falls for Michael and becomes deeply entangled in the brothers' fight for freedom.

characters.name: Paul Kellerman
characters.description: A ruthless operative for The Company turned reluctant ally after uncovering the conspiracy against the Burrows brothers.

characters.name: Charles 'C-Note' Patoshik
characters.description: A Fox River inmate who joins the escape and later becomes a key ally to Michael on the outside.

characters.name: John Abruzzi
characters.description: Head of the Chicago mob, imprisoned at Fox River, who provides crucial resources for the escape.

characters.name: David 'Tweener' Apolskis
characters.description: A young, erratic Fox River inmate who joins the escape plan but struggles to find his footing on the outside.

characters.name: Veronica Donovan
characters.description: The Burrows brothers' childhood friend and lawyer who fights to prove Lincoln's innocence.

characters.name: LJ Burrows
characters.description: Lincoln's son, targeted by The Company and forced into hiding and eventually incarceration to pressure his father.

characters.name: Nick Savrinn
characters.description: A civil rights lawyer working alongside Veronica Donovan to expose the conspiracy against Lincoln.

characters.name: James Whistler
characters.description: A mysterious prisoner at Sona whom Michael is coerced into breaking out in exchange for Sara's freedom.

characters.name: Gretchen Morgan
characters.description: A cold and calculating operative for The Company who becomes both an enemy and uneasy ally to Michael's crew.

characters.name: Norman 'Lechero' St. John
characters.description: The de facto leader of Sona prison, controlling the inmates in the absence of any guards inside the walls.

characters.name: Donald Self
characters.description: A ruthless government handler who blackmails Michael's team into retrieving the Scylla card for him.

characters.name: David 'Whip' Martin
characters.description: A fellow inmate at Ogygia who partners with 'Kaniel Outis' (Michael) to survive and eventually escape the prison.

characters.name: Sheba
characters.description: A resourceful resistance fighter in Yemen who becomes entangled with Michael during his time at Ogygia.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.description: Michael Scofield gets himself imprisoned at Fox River State Penitentiary to save his brother Lincoln from death row, hatching an elaborate escape plan.

seasons.title: Season 2
seasons.description: The 'Fox River Eight' scatter across the country as fugitives, pursued by Agent Mahone while trying to evade capture and clear Lincoln's name.

seasons.title: Season 3
seasons.description: Michael is imprisoned in the lawless Sona Federal Penitentiary in Panama and is forced to break out fellow inmate James Whistler for The Company.

seasons.title: Season 4
seasons.description: The team is recruited by Homeland Security to retrieve a mysterious data card called Scylla from The Company, uncovering deeper conspiracies.

seasons.title: Season 5
seasons.description: Presumed dead for years, Michael resurfaces alive in Yemen's Ogygia Prison under the alias Kaniel Outis, forcing Lincoln and Sara to mount another rescue.
